problems: All five binding claims rest on in-vitro motif predictions, not demonstrated cellular binding; H3 also has model disagreement about direction.
No regulatory element overlaps the variant in the cited cCRE resources. This does not show that no regulatory activity exists, but leaves the proposed element unidentified.

FAM110B is nearest by TSS distance, which does not establish it as the target. There is no direct variant-to-FAM110B evidence; the absence of a significant GTEx eQTL is limited negative evidence, and SCREEN gene links were not tested.
Expression in Hep 3B2.1-7 is contextual evidence, not proof of occupancy. E25 and E26 do not provide tested-negative ChIP evidence for the stated context.

There is no cited link from the variant or proposed regulatory effect to LDL cholesterol. E27 is limited to the specified FAM110B/free-cholesterol-in-large-LDL association and does not establish or rule out broader LDL-trait relationships.

This would test variant function and target-gene assignment, neither of which the new lookups establish.

games.reason: Both chains lack reported ChIP-seq peaks at the variant, while HMGA1 has higher expression (E13, E15). The binding evidence favors A: RELA’s mapped model consistently predicts stronger binding to alt T (1 of 1 models passes), whereas HMGA1’s models disagree on direction despite the reported alt-favoring result (E13, E15).

The downstream links do not distinguish the chains, and both TFs are expressed in the stated context with no reported peak at the variant. RELA has a clear alt-binding prediction from its mapped model (E13), whereas the HMGA1 family result says the models disagree on direction despite reporting an overall alt-favoring effect (E15). That makes B’s binding link more direct and internally consistent.

evidence.summary: ENCODE has no RELA ChIP-seq experiment in biosamples matching 'Hep 3B2.1-7', so ENCODE says nothing about it there, for or against. ENCODE assayed RELA in: GM12878, GM12891, GM12892, GM15510, GM18526, GM18951, GM19099, GM19193, HepG2, K562, WTC11. ReMap 2022 has no RELA peak over the variant (ReMap lists peaks only, so this is no evidence against binding).

evidence.source: ENCODE experiment search; ReMap 2022 (UCSC track ReMapTFs)
evidence.summary: ENCODE has no CASZ1 ChIP-seq experiment in biosamples matching 'Hep 3B2.1-7', so ENCODE says nothing about it there, for or against. ENCODE never assayed CASZ1. ReMap 2022 has no CASZ1 peak over the variant (ReMap lists peaks only, so this is no evidence against binding).
Open Targets: no association between FAM110B and free cholesterol in large LDL measurement (EFO_0022176); no evidence there links them.
